issues.description: Most bullets are phrased as 'general background knowledge' and therefore are not directly supported by a retrieved excerpt. Although labelling them as background is acceptable, the section would be stronger if key contractual points (DPA, data residency, deletion rights, SLA metrics, on‑prem vs multitenant tradeoffs) were explicitly cross‑referenced to the existing chapters or KB excerpts that discuss them.
issues.required_fix: Add explicit cross‑references to relevant parts of the manual (e.g. section 8.2 'Výběr enterprise řešení a smluvní požadavky', 9.4.2 'Checklist soukromí a GDPR pro RAG', and 2.2/9.3.x where DPA/DPIA are discussed). If you want to keep new detailed contractual recommendations, retrieve and cite supporting KB evidence.

issues.description: The phrase 'možnost vymazání indexovaných materiálů a loggerů' is slightly ambiguous (what exactly should be deletable: embeddings/indexes, raw documents, audit logs?).
issues.required_fix: Clarify the intended scope (e.g. 'smazání indexovaných dokumentů/embeddings a/nebo auditních logů') and, if applicable, indicate retention windows or conditions under which deletion is allowed (or cross‑refer to DPIA/checklist).

issues.description: The bullet 'Doporučené otázky pro právní oddělení' promises a 'rychlý seznam' but does not include concrete example questions to enable copy‑paste use by legal teams.
issues.required_fix: Either include a short, concrete copy‑pasteable list of 6–8 sample contractual/legal questions (e.g. existence of DPA, subcontractor list, audit rights, data deletion procedures, incident reporting timelines, liability/indemnity, data residency) OR cross‑reference the editable policy templates in 9.3.x and the DPA checklist in 9.4.2. If adding specific sample questions, retrieve supporting KB excerpts or mark them as general background knowledge.

issues.required_fix: Ensure the citation style of this footnote matches the rest of the manual (either keep plain 'Source: ...' for KB notes or convert to the project citation macro used elsewhere). No change required if consistent.
